def: a (double) stall (for cattle); also a (two-pronged) hook (for flaying animals on)

occurrences.text: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
